             glyphs.star_unexplored,
             glyphs.transit,
             glyphs.warning,

             glyphs.severity_historic,
             glyphs.severity_urgent,
         ];
         assert!(chars.iter().all(|ch| ch.is_ascii()));
     }
 
     #[test]
     fn unicode_mode_uses_non_private_unicode_symbols() {
         let glyphs = glyphs_for_mode(VisualMode::Unicode);
         let chars = [
             glyphs.star,
             glyphs.star_unexplored,
             glyphs.transit,
             glyphs.warning,
             glyphs.special,
             glyphs.anomaly,

             glyphs.separator_dot,
             glyphs.status_done,
             glyphs.severity_historic,
             glyphs.severity_urgent,

                 && !('\u{100000}'..='\u{10fffd}').contains(ch)

         assert!(('\u{e000}'..='\u{f8ff}').contains(&glyphs.palette_cursor));
     }
 }

442:         .fg(Color::Magenta)

445:         .fg(Color::Yellow)
446:         .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD);
447: 
448:     for mission in game_state.fleet_missions.values() {
449:         let origin = match game_state.stars.get(&mission.origin) {
450:             Some(star) if star.sector == sector_id => star,

772: fn render_known_lanes_in_sector(
773:     cells: &mut Vec<CellCommand>,
774:     game_state: &GameState,
775:     app_state: &AppState,
776:     sector_id: SectorId,
777:     viewport: &MapViewport,
778:     glyphs: &GlyphSet,
779: ) {
780:     let player_has_cartography = game_state
781:         .empires
782:         .get(&game_state.player_empire)
783:         .is_some_and(|empire| {
784:             empire
785:                 .research
786:                 .completed
787:                 .contains(&TechId::HYPERSPACE_CARTOGRAPHY)
788:         });
789: 
790:     let highlighted_lane = app_state.navigation.selected_star.and_then(|destination| {
791:         let origin = game_state
792:             .fleets
793:             .values()
794:             .find(|fleet| {
795:                 fleet.owner == game_state.player_empire
796:                     && !game_state.scout_missions.contains_key(&fleet.id)
797:                     && !game_state.survey_missions.contains_key(&fleet.id)
798:                     && !game_state.fleet_missions.contains_key(&fleet.id)
799:             })
800:             .map(|fleet| fleet.location)?;
801:         if origin == destination {
802:             return None;
803:         }
804:         game_core::HyperspaceLane::new(origin, destination)
805:             .filter(|lane| game_state.known_hyperspace_lanes.contains(lane))
806:             .filter(|_| player_has_cartography)
807:     });
808: 
809:     for lane in &game_state.known_hyperspace_lanes {
810:         let Some(a) = game_state.stars.get(&lane.a()) else {
811:             continue;
812:         };
813:         let Some(b) = game_state.stars.get(&lane.b()) else {
814:             continue;
815:         };
816:         if a.sector != sector_id || b.sector != sector_id {
817:             continue;
818:         }
819: 
820:         let is_highlight = highlighted_lane == Some(*lane);
821:         let style = if is_highlight {
822:             Style::default().fg(Color::LightCyan)
823:         } else {
824:             Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray)
825:         };
826:         let glyph = if is_highlight {
827:             glyphs.lane_highlight
828:         } else {
829:             glyphs.lane
830:         };
831:         for ScreenPoint { x, y } in viewport.world_line_to_cells(
832:             WorldPoint::new(a.x as f64, a.y as f64),
833:             WorldPoint::new(b.x as f64, b.y as f64),
834:         ) {
835:             cells.push(CellCommand {
836:                 layer: MapLayer::Route,
837:                 order: 0,
838:                 x,
839:                 y,
840:                 symbol: Some(glyph),
841:                 style,
842:                 protect: 0,
843:             });
844:         }
845:     }
846: }

```rust
    let hostile_fleets = game_state

            game_state
                .stars

                .is_some_and(|star| star.sector == sector.id)

                && game_state
                    .relationship_status(game_state.player_empire, fleet.owner)
                    .is_hostile_or_war()
        })
        .count();
```

And `fog` is already computed above. The fix is to gate this on `fog == Visible`. If the sector is not visible, the player shouldn't know about hostile fleets.

The simplest approach: only count hostile fleets when the sector is visible. Otherwise, set to 0.

Actually, let me think about this more carefully. The `FogState::Unexplored` means the player has never explored any star in the sector - they really shouldn't see hostile fleet info. For `FogState::Explored`, the player has explored at least one star in the sector but doesn't have current visibility. In this case, the player might know about some fleets but not all.

The PR comment says: "Consider restricting the hostile-fleet count to fleets the player can actually observe (e.g. using `visible_star_ids`/`star_fog_state`) or suppressing the threat meter / hostile note when the sector is not `Visible`."

I'll take the simpler approach: suppress the hostile count when the sector is not `Visible`. This aligns with the fog-of-war principle.
